game.name: Dynasty Warriors 5 : Empires (USA)
game.desc: Dynasty Warriors 5: Empires on Xbox 360 is an action game in which you will explore China in the company of legendary warriors. Before each battle, gather your war council to determine the military and political rules of the kingdom, and then fight! Choose the officers of your attack force, control over 2,000 officers, try to attract captured lieutenants to your cause or drive them out of your kingdom.
